_README: Static tide & tidal-stream data for Dublin Bay / Dún Laoghaire.
This file is INTENTIONALLY MOSTLY EMPTY until verified data is added.
Replace `events` with values from an authoritative source:
https://easytide.admiralty.co.uk/   (Admiralty EasyTide, Dún Laoghaire)
https://www.met.ie/forecasts/marine-inland-lakes/sea-level-and-tide
Replace `defaultTideRose` and per-mark roses in `marksTideRose` with
values from the Admiralty Tidal Stream Atlas (Irish Sea, NP218) or
from local racing knowledge. Streams are typically read at the hour
from HW Dublin (or HW Liverpool, depending on the chartlet).
SCHEMA
events[]: each = {
datetime: 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM',     local Europe/Dublin time
type:     'high' | 'low',
height_m: number                  metres above chart datum
defaultTideRose[]: 13 entries, h = -6..+6 hours from HW.
Each entry = { h: int, set: 0..359 deg true, drift: knots }.
Used for any mark without an explicit rose in marksTideRose.
marksTideRose: { 'A': [ ...13 entries... ], 'B': [ ... ] }
Override per-mark when racing experience says the stream is
different there (e.g. Pier Heads / Burford Bank).
The app hides every tide UI element silently while data is empty.
As soon as `events` has at least 2 entries that bracket NOW, the
tide card appears. As soon as a tide rose is present, tide arrows
appear at every mark on the chart and the Steer view shows a
tide-push cue.
